integrity: Complete integral argument, direct matrix verification and exact small Smith computations; no independent audit or external mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Only the canonical multiset deletion matrix and full binary interlacing matrix; no arbitrary balanced weightings. The cyclic integers j are diagonal-form entries rather than Smith divisibility-ordered entries. Finite numerical verification is not the infinite proof. Historical priority over all implicit classical symmetric-power formulations remains uncertain.
title: Integral deletion torsion and unimodular interlacing in balanced multiset incidences
